Relabeled from v1-bug: not one of GATE-0's four recorded 1.35 bugs, so it is counted, not treated as a known bug. The per-type resolver cache. Disabling or mis-filling it changes the answer only when two resolvers can take one requirement: 1.35 then prefers the one cached for the type over declaration order (verified: a predicate resolver declared first loses a requirement it accepts to a string resolver cached earlier). That preference is an accident of the cache, not a contract to keep.
